title: Patient Payment Plan Add-On Enrollment Allowances by Tier
content:
New eligible balances may join an open **Patient Payment Plan** only on tiers that allow add-ons. The table states whether new eligible balances may be added to an open plan, the number of add-on enrollments allowed in any rolling 12 months, and the months added to the remaining term when a balance is added (never beyond the tier's maximum term counted from the first due date).

| Tier | Add-ons allowed | Add-on enrollments in any rolling 12 months | Term extension per add-on (months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | No | 0 | 0 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | Yes | 2 | 0 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | Yes | 3 | 6 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | Yes | 3 | 6 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | Yes | 4 | 12 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | Yes | 4 | 12 |

## Recalculation basis and tier overflow (all tiers)

- **How the installment is recomputed after an add-on:** the new plan balance is spread over the remaining term.
- **When an add-on pushes the plan balance above the tier maximum:** the patient is re-offered a plan on the next tier.

On a hypothetical Extended-tier plan, a third add-on in a rolling 12 months is within the allowance of 3; a fourth is not.
